text: Bel fell, Dagon was broken. [[2]became ; [1]Their carved images] for the wild beasts; and cattle lift them being bound for a load, tiring, fainting,
and hungering, not being able together; the ones who are not able to be delivered from war; but they themselves [[2]as captives [1]are led away].
Hear me, O house ; of Jacob, and all the rest ; of Israel! O ones being lifted from the belly, and being corrected from childhood
until old age; I am, and until whenever you should become aged, I am. I endure you. I made, and I shall spare. I shall take up and I shall deliver you.
To whom do you liken me? Behold cunningly contrive, O misleading ones!
And the ones uniting in gold from a money bag, and silver in a yoke balance scale; shall establish by weight; and ones hiring a goldsmith made handmade idols, and bowing they do obeisance to it.

They lift it upon the shoulder, and they go. And if they put it upon ; its place, it remains. In no way shall it move, and who ever should yell to it, in no way shall it listen; [[4]from [5]hurt [1]in no way [2]shall it deliver [3]him].
Remember these things; and moan! Change your mind, O ones being misled! Turn ; in heart!
Remember the things; prior from the eon! For I am ; God, and there is no other besides me;
announcing formerly the last things; before their taking place, and are completed. And I said, All ; my counsel will stand, and all as much as I have planned I will do;

calling [[2]from [3]the east [1]the winged creature], and from a land at a distance, for the things which I have planned. And indeed I spoke, and indeed I led. I created and I did. I led him, and I prospered ; his way.
Hear me, O ones destroying the heart! O ones far from ; righteousness.
I brought near ; my righteousness, in no way is it at a distance, and the deliverance the one by me, I will not be slow about; I have appointed in Zion deliverance to Israel for glory.
